Mira: Quick check: who wants to join a 10-minute 'desk swap' roulette at 3pm? Try a different view, promise to return plants. :round_pushpin:
Omar: In. I need new glare angles. Also bringing extra screen wipe.
Ben: Tempting. Will swap if there's a snack bribe. :eyes: 
Tasha: I'll judge the swaps on 'chair comfort' and 'plant vibes'.
Coffee-Bot: Heads-up: communal snacks labelled 'take one' only. Please be considerate.
Mira: Poll: :white_check_mark: = in, :eyes: = spectate, :coffee: = only if snacks
Omar: :white_check_mark:
Ben: :coffee:
Tasha: :eyes:
Mira: Current: in=1, spectate=1, snacks=1
Mira: Bonus micro-game: best 1-line caption about desk-swapping wins a bagel. Drop your one-liners now.
Ben: "New desk, who dis?"
Omar: "Trading views like baseball cards."
Tasha: "Seat roulette: may your back be blessed."
Mira: GIF of tiny hamster pushing a wheel.
Echo-Bot: Reaction tally: Ben +2 :thumbsup:, Omar +1 :laughing:, Tasha +1 :heart. Winner: Ben. Bagel reserved.
Ben: Accepting bagel. Will report on ergonomics and plant morale.
Mira: Tiny logistic: please put a note on desks you borrow and return things exactly where you found them. Also no permanent plant kidnappings. :seedling:
Omar: Agreed. Also I brought little 'welcome cards' for swapped desks (handmade sticky notes).
Tasha: If anyone wants a two-line desk haiku to leave behind, I volunteer.
Mira: See you at 3. Last rule: if you find a mysterious rubber duck on your keyboard, keep it. It means good luck. :duck:
